newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 4.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index down 4.6 pct.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was down 3.48 points, or 4.60 percent, at 72.15 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell a provisional 126.74 points to 3,383.31.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 9.82 percent from 10.35 percent on Thursday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
